+# Bhavcopy fallback implementation — 3 November 2026
+
+Implementation is authorized by the new-chat handoff. Production imports, identity writes,
+release/portable builds, commits and pushes remain outside this task. The existing dirty
+NIFTY certification, importer guard, chart-pattern work and generated files were preserved.
+
+## Normal acquisition and coverage contract
+
+Daily Update, Date Range and the existing Full History mode retain daily archives as primary.
+After archive staging, missing supported index/date work is grouped per index into requests
+of at most 366 inclusive calendar days. Resolved intervening dates are excluded from accepted
+results. There is no pre-2012 request restriction. Update retains its existing forward window
+and 18:00 local cutoff; explicit Date Range is required for older gaps.
+
+The supported historical API subset is deliberately bounded:
+
+| Official request | Canonical storage | Accepted legacy alias examples | Admission floor |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| NIFTY 50 | NIFTY | SPCNXNIFTY, CNXNIFTY | 1996-04-22 |
+| NIFTY BANK | BANKNIFTY | CNXBANK | 2003-09-15 |
+| NIFTY NEXT 50 | NIFTYNEXT50 | CNXNIFTYJUNIOR | 1996-12-24 |
+| NIFTY 100 | NIFTY100 | CNX100 | 2005-12-01 |
+| NIFTY 500 | NIFTY500 | CNX500 | 2011-01-03, conservative evidence floor |
+| NIFTY IT | NIFTYIT | CNXIT | 2011-01-03, conservative evidence floor |
+
+Identity uses the existing explicit alias registry, never a generated ticker. The retained
+six-index 3–7 January 2011 observations in the approved plan establish old-name compatibility.
+The retained certification manifest also records the recent 9–13 January 2025 API response and
+13 January 2025 daily archive; those price requests were not repeated here.
+
+The admission floors are separate from request limits: earlier requested rows are retained
+in evidence and held. NIFTY 50 launch is documented by
+[NSE](https://www.nseindia.com/static/resources/nifty50-silver-jubilee-20-years-derivatives).
+Launch dates for [Bank](https://www.niftyindices.com/Factsheet/ind_nifty_bank.pdf),
+[Next 50](https://www.niftyindices.com/Factsheet/ind_next50.pdf), and
+[100](https://www.niftyindices.com/Factsheet/ind_nifty_100.pdf) come from official factsheets.
+The current [500](https://www.niftyindices.com/Factsheet/ind_nifty_500.pdf) and
+[IT](https://www.niftyindices.com/Factsheet/ind_nifty_it.pdf) factsheets leave Launch Date blank.
+Their base dates are not substituted for launch dates. Earlier admission needs additional
+evidence; six supported indices are not the full present or historical universe.
+
+Requests are serial, one attempt each, with the existing 30-second HTTP timeout and an 8 MiB
+response limit. HTTP 403/429 or three consecutive failures stop further live requests in that
+run; remaining requests are reported unattempted. Empty data, refusal, missing response data,
+invalid JSON, invalid/partial OHLC, identity mismatch, out-of-window dates and conflicting
+duplicates have distinct outcomes. Internal stop is checked before/after requests. Normal
+Bhavcopy still has no user cancellation button; closing the window hides it and does not cancel.
+
+## Storage, provenance and recovery
+
+Both normal NSE daily index rows and fallback rows are additive. Existing canonical and
+accepted alias files are read once per relevant symbol/range, not once per requested day.
+Matching rows are skipped; conflicting stored or incoming rows are held. Unknown volume is
+retained as unknown in raw/normalized evidence; storage-required zero is not certified zero
+trading volume. Existing quotations are never selected for overwrite by this route.
+
+Fallback observations become the existing staged CSV contract, then enter the existing
+Bhavcopy recovery journal and symbol-batched writer. The disabled legacy historical writer
+remains disabled. The price-store operation permit covers staging/import; active database is
+rechecked before import; additive checks precede journal creation and replay. Existing binary
+worker limits and immediate historical/rewrite/replay durability are unchanged. The current
+source cap is two workers, stricter than the four-worker ceiling in AGENTS.md; this task did
+not raise it. Only existing journal-governed APPEND_NEWEST buffering remains eligible.
+
+No schema migration was needed. NSE index `download_log` records use `partial` with a note,
+including replay. Partial records can advance the forward Update date but never establish
+full-day coverage or suppress explicit NSE index requests. Equity prefiltering and its 31-day
+physical reconciliation boundary are unchanged. NSE index Date Range may retry daily archives
+on a rerun; existing supported physical rows suppress unnecessary API requests.
+
+During a deliberate user download, `bhavcopy_index_evidence/` under the selected database
+stores immutable content-addressed raw responses, request URL/date scope, normalized held
+rows/volume provenance, pre-write outcomes and completion receipts. These are separate from
+recoverable write journals. A pre-write receipt alone is not evidence of successful import.
+Archive diagnostics, API request outcomes, row insertions and unresolved coverage remain
+separately visible. Expected archive misses and retained integrity/source failures can coexist
+with successful partial fallback acquisition; request completion does not certify history.
+
+## UI and terminal status
+
+The normal Bhavcopy controls now explain the bounded subset. The temporary NIFTY Back History
+tab and importer navigation hint are removed. The prior review implementation, evidence,
+commands and receipts remain; existing manual-import undo/recovery stays available in Import
+CSV → Manual Import Recovery. New normal fallback writes use Bhavcopy's own recovery lifecycle.
+The generic NIFTY CSV guard is unchanged.
+
+Terminal status is dismissed on close, direct window-store close and unmount. An active hidden
+run retains progress and logs. Completion while hidden clears the global terminal badge;
+reopening while still running retains the active state. Late progress cannot restart a
+terminal/dismissed run. The shared downloading flag prevents a second overlapping UI command.
+
+## BSE read-only diagnosis and bounded repair
+
+The Documents profile registry resolved `E:\TA Projects\EOD Charting Platform\EOD DATABASE`.
+SQLite was opened with `mode=ro` and `PRAGMA query_only=ON`; binary files were opened read-only.
+This is the registered database inspected, not an assertion that every portable profile uses it.
+
+| File | Physical count | First / last record | January 2011 | January 2020 | December 2023 |
+|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|
+| BSE/TCS.eod | 697 | 2023-12-05 / 2026-10-26 | 0 | 0 | 1 |
+| BSE/532540.eod | 4,525 | 2006-03-01 / 2024-07-05 | 20 | 23 | 20 |
+| BSE/JAYUSH.eod | 678 | 2023-12-05 / 2026-10-26 | 0 | 0 | 1 |
+| BSE/513252.eod | 3,846 | 2006-03-01 / 2024-07-05 | 20 | 21 | 20 |
+| BSE_INDEX/SENSEX.eod | 8,695 | 1991-01-02 / 2026-10-26 | 20 | 23 | 20 |
+
+The numeric/ticker overlaps from December 2023 through July 2024 contain 126 TCS and 125
+JAYUSH dates with no OHLCV conflict. This is corroboration, not identity proof by price.
+The saved JAYUSH row explicitly maps to code 513252; TCS has no saved `bse_security_code`.
+The numeric records have no ISIN, and TCS has no dated identity-history mapping. No mapping
+was synthesized or written. TCS therefore remains held until an authoritative mapping is
+reviewed and saved through the identity workflow.
+
+January 2011 logs contain 20 `ok` BSE dates with 2,982–3,111 rows per date, and 20 `ok` BSE_INDEX
+dates with 12 rows each. January 26 is the lone error in each category. The physical samples
+explain the 20 prefiltered days and the ticker chart discrepancy; they do not prove complete
+coverage of all BSE securities, all sessions or all stored file counts.
+
+The focused chart repair joins a saved, unambiguous six-digit BSE security code into its ticker
+context. It excludes T+0, checks code-file identity/scale, rejects conflicting ISINs and overlap
+bars, and does not modify identity or quotation files. It applies to JAYUSH in the inspected
+database; TCS remains unresolved. The production unique-code index prevents duplicate saved
+code ownership, and the read path also checks ambiguity.
+
+BSE notice 20101122-22, issued 22 November 2010, lists 26 January 2011 as Republic Day.
+The [archived BSE notice copy](https://www.isesec.com/Admin/Circular/20114899.pdf) provides the
+issuer text; direct BSE notice URLs were unavailable through web retrieval. The planner now
+recognizes that exact BSE/BSE_INDEX date without changing database holiday rows. Special-session
+overrides retain precedence. No HTML/network failure creates a holiday. The evidenced storage
+gap was identity continuity, so no additional BSE price probes or source adapter were warranted.
+
+## Validation and remaining acceptance
+
+Initial focused fallback tests: PASS, 10 tests, after correcting a test fixture's write API call.
+The first wrapper run was blocked by another Cargo build; no concurrent compilation was started.
+Initial BSE fixture run: FAIL at fixture setup because it duplicated a unique saved code; the
+fixture was corrected to respect the production constraint. Final focused results are recorded
+below when complete. No active quotation writes, live price probes, release builds, commits or
+pushes were performed.
+
+Native checks after the user's portable rebuild remain required:
+
+1. January 2011 NSE Date Range: archive attempts, six-index fallback, held/missing counts and retained diagnostics.
+2. A multi-year range: automatic non-overlapping chunks up to 366 days; one recent unresolved date follows the same route.
+3. Isolated native database rerun: no duplicate rows; deliberate stored conflict preserved and reported; interrupted import recovery.
+4. Failure/success close, title-bar/direct close, active hide/reopen, completion while hidden and late events; retained logs.
+5. JAYUSH raw/adjusted chart includes verified code history; T+0 remains separate. TCS stays unmapped until reviewed identity evidence is saved.
+6. BSE January 26 is excluded, January 25 remains eligible, special sessions remain included; no broad equity coverage claim.
+
+Backups: `backups/pre_opencode_changes_20261103_122449_bhavcopy-fallback`,
+`backups/pre_opencode_changes_20261103_123659_bse-code-continuity`, and
+`backups/REDACTED`.
*** End Patch"));
